description: This file defines the MatchDifference class used for tracking differences in request matching, including detailed failure information and logging capabilities.

classes.name: MatchDifference
classes.description: Class for representing and managing differences between expected and actual request matchings, including detailed failure info and logging.

classes.name: MatchDifference.Field
classes.description: Enum representing different fields of an HTTP request that can be compared for differences.

methods.name: addDifference
methods.description: Adds a difference message to the internal differences map, optionally logging the event.

methods.name: getLogCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the log correlation ID from the associated request.

methods.name: currentField
methods.description: Sets the current field being compared.

methods.name: getDifferences
methods.description: Returns the list of differences for a specific field.

methods.name: addDifferences
methods.description: Adds multiple differences from a provided map.
